claims.text: Machine-learning-based phase prediction can be used to control phase evolution in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning can identify optimal processing conditions for Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning can identify optimal alloy compositions within the Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni system.
Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni high-entropy alloys contain multiple constituent phases.
Machine-learning algorithms can predict phase formation and phase stability.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction will improve control of phase evolution.
Improved control of phase evolution will produce consistent and predictable outcomes.
Traditional alloy-design methods may be ineffective for high-entropy alloys because of their compositional complexity and phase behavior.
The proposed method is limited to Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni high-entropy alloys and may not apply to other alloy systems.
The effectiveness of machine-learning-based phase prediction for controlling phase evolution in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni high-entropy alloys is uncertain.
